# gezor_aws_connection (Resource)

Links the workspace to your AWS account. Gezor validates access on every create and update. One per workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_aws_cloudformation" "this" {}

resource "aws_cloudformation_stack" "gezor" {
  name          = "gezor-access"
  template_body = data.gezor_aws_cloudformation.this.template_body
  capabilities  = ["CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM"]
}

resource "gezor_aws_connection" "this" {
  auth_mode = "assume_role"
  role_arn  = aws_cloudformation_stack.gezor.outputs["RoleArn"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) Access key id for `credentials`. Write-only.
- `auth_mode` (String) `assume_role` (recommended; deploy the template from `gezor_aws_cloudformation` first) or `credentials`.
- `role_arn` (String) IAM role ARN for `assume_role`.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key for `credentials`. Write-only.
- `test_permissions` (Boolean) Also check the permissions Gezor needs.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`. Changing it recreates the resource.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String)
- `external_id` (String)
- `id` (String) Always `aws`.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Append @<workspace> to import from a workspace other than the provider default.
terraform import gezor_aws_connection.example aws
```
